title: द्वात्रिंशत्तमोऽध्यायः

summary.en: Yudhishthira tells Draupadi that her words verge on unbelief. He does right not for the reward but because it is right; one must never doubt dharma or the gods, for the fruits of action come in time, and by grace a mortal reaches immortality.
summary.kn: ನಿನ್ನ ಮಾತುಗಳು ನಾಸ್ತಿಕತೆಯ ಅಂಚಿನಲ್ಲಿವೆ ಎಂದು ಯುಧಿಷ್ಠಿರನು ದ್ರೌಪದಿಗೆ ಹೇಳುತ್ತಾನೆ. ತಾನು ಫಲಕ್ಕಾಗಿ ಅಲ್ಲ, ಧರ್ಮವಾದ್ದರಿಂದ ಧರ್ಮ ಮಾಡುವೆ; ಧರ್ಮವನ್ನಾಗಲಿ ದೇವತೆಗಳನ್ನಾಗಲಿ ಎಂದೂ ಸಂಶಯಿಸಬಾರದು, ಕರ್ಮಫಲ ಕಾಲಕ್ಕೆ ಬರುತ್ತದೆ, ಅನುಗ್ರಹದಿಂದ ಮರ್ತ್ಯನು ಅಮರತ್ವ ಪಡೆಯುತ್ತಾನೆ ಎನ್ನುತ್ತಾನೆ.
summary.hi: युधिष्ठिर द्रौपदी से कहते हैं कि उनके वचन नास्तिकता की सीमा पर हैं। वे फल के लिए नहीं, धर्म होने के कारण धर्म करते हैं; धर्म या देवताओं पर कभी सन्देह नहीं करना चाहिए, क्योंकि कर्मों का फल समय पर आता है और कृपा से मनुष्य अमरता पाता है।
summary.te: నీ మాటలు నాస్తికత్వానికి దగ్గరగా ఉన్నాయని యుధిష్ఠిరుడు ద్రౌపదితో అంటాడు. తాను ఫలం కోసం కాక ధర్మం కనుకనే ధర్మం చేస్తానని; ధర్మాన్ని గాని దేవతలను గాని ఎన్నడూ సందేహించరాదని, కర్మఫలం కాలానికి వస్తుందని, అనుగ్రహంతో మర్త్యుడు అమరత్వం పొందుతాడని చెబుతాడు.
summary.ta: உன் சொற்கள் நாத்திகத்தின் எல்லையில் உள்ளன என்று யுதிஷ்டிரர் திரௌபதியிடம் சொல்கிறார். தாம் பலனுக்காக அல்ல, அது அறம் என்பதால் அறம் செய்வதாகவும், அறத்தையோ தேவர்களையோ ஒருபோதும் ஐயுறக் கூடாது, வினைப்பயன் காலத்தில் வரும், அருளால் மனிதன் அமரத்துவம் அடைவான் என்றும் சொல்கிறார்.
summary.ml: നിങ്ങളുടെ വാക്കുകൾ അവിശ്വാസത്തോട് അടുക്കുന്നുവെന്ന് യുധിഷ്ഠിരൻ ദ്രൗപദിയോട് പറയുന്നു. പ്രതിഫലത്തിനുവേണ്ടിയല്ല, ശരിയായതിനാലാണ് താൻ ശരി ചെയ്യുന്നത്; ധർമ്മത്തെയോ ദേവന്മാരെയോ ഒരിക്കലും സംശയിക്കരുത്. കർമ്മഫലം സമയമാകുമ്പോൾ എത്തും, കൃപയാൽ മർത്യന് അമരത്വം ലഭിക്കും.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 3.32; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Mon Apr 11 2022

verses.text: युधिष्ठिर उवाच

meaning.en: Yudhishthira said:

verses.text:
वल्गु चित्रपदं श्लक्ष्णं याज्ञसेनि त्वया वचः ।
उक्तं तच्छ्रुतमस्माभिर्नास्तिक्यं तु प्रभाषसे ॥

meaning.en: "Your speech, daughter of Yajnasena, was charming, beautifully worded and smooth, and we heard it; but what you are saying leans toward unbelief."

verses.text:
नाहं धर्मफलान्वेषी राजपुत्रि चराम्युत ।
ददामि देयमित्येव यजे यष्टव्यमित्युत ॥

meaning.en: "Princess, I do not practice dharma looking for its reward. I give because giving is to be done, and I sacrifice because sacrifice is to be done."

verses.text:
अस्तु वात्र फलं मा वा कर्तव्यं पुरुषेण यत् ।
गृहानावसता कृष्णे यथाशक्ति करोमि तत् ॥

meaning.en: "Whether there is fruit here or not, Krishna, I do what a man living in a household ought to do, as far as I can."

verses.text:
धर्मं चरामि सुश्रोणि न धर्मफलकारणात् ।
आगमाननतिक्रम्य सतां वृत्तमवेक्ष्य च ।
धर्म एव मनः कृष्णे स्वभावाच्चैव मे धृतम् ॥

meaning.en: "I follow dharma, fair lady, not for the sake of its reward; keeping to the scriptures and looking to the conduct of the good, my mind is set on dharma itself, and by nature too."

verses.text:
न धर्मफलमाप्नोति यो धर्मं दोग्धुमिच्छति ।
यश्चैनं शङ्कते कृत्वा नास्तिक्यात्पापचेतनः ॥

meaning.en: "The man who wants to milk dharma for its fruit does not obtain that fruit, nor does he who, having practiced it, doubts it with an unbelieving, sinful mind."

verses.text:
अतिवादान्मदाच्चैव मा धर्ममतिशङ्किथाः ।
धर्मातिशङ्की पुरुषस्तिर्यग्गतिपरायणः ॥

meaning.en: "Do not doubt dharma out of excessive talk or pride; a man who doubts dharma ends up in the lower births."

verses.text:
धर्मो यस्यातिशङ्क्यः स्यादार्षं वा दुर्बलात्मनः ।
वेदाच्छूद्र इवापेयात्स लोकादजरामरात् ॥

meaning.en: "The weak-minded man who greatly doubts dharma or the sages' word falls away from the Veda as a shudra does, and from the world free of old age and death."

verses.text:
वेदाध्यायी धर्मपरः कुले जातो यशस्विनि ।
स्थविरेषु स योक्तव्यो राजभिर्धर्मचारिभिः ॥

meaning.en: "A glorious woman, a man born in a good family who studies the Veda and is devoted to dharma should be placed among the elders by righteous kings."

verses.text:
पापीयान्हि स शूद्रेभ्यस्तस्करेभ्यो विशेषतः ।
शास्त्रातिगो मन्दबुद्धिर्यो धर्ममतिशङ्कते ॥

meaning.en: "But the dull-minded man who transgresses the scriptures and greatly doubts dharma is worse than shudras, and especially worse than thieves."

verses.text:
प्रत्यक्षं हि त्वया दृष्ट ऋषिर्गच्छन्महातपाः ।
मार्कण्डेयोऽप्रमेयात्मा धर्मेण चिरजीविताम् ॥

meaning.en: "You have seen with your own eyes the great ascetic Markandeya, immeasurable in spirit, going about, long-lived through dharma."

verses.text:
व्यासो वसिष्ठो मैत्रेयो नारदो लोमशः शुकः ।
अन्ये च ऋषयः सिद्धा धर्मेणैव सुचेतसः ॥

meaning.en: "Vyasa, Vasishtha, Maitreya, Narada, Lomasha, Shuka and other sages and siddhas have clear minds through dharma alone."

verses.text:
प्रत्यक्षं पश्यसि ह्येतान्दिव्ययोगसमन्वितान् ।
शापानुग्रहणे शक्तान्देवैरपि गरीयसः ॥

meaning.en: "You see them directly, endowed with divine yoga, able to curse and to bless, weightier even than the gods."

verses.text:
एते हि धर्ममेवादौ वर्णयन्ति सदा मम ।
कर्तव्यममरप्रख्याः प्रत्यक्षागमबुद्धयः ॥

meaning.en: "These men, like immortals, whose understanding rests on direct perception and scripture, always tell me that dharma comes first and must be done."

verses.text:
अतो नार्हसि कल्याणि धातारं धर्ममेव च ।
रजोमूढेन मनसा क्षेप्तुं शङ्कितुमेव च ॥

meaning.en: "So, auspicious lady, you should not reproach the Ordainer or dharma with a mind clouded by passion, nor doubt them."

verses.text:
धर्मातिशङ्की नान्यस्मिन्प्रमाणमधिगच्छति ।
आत्मप्रमाण उन्नद्धः श्रेयसो ह्यवमन्यकः ॥

meaning.en: "A man who greatly doubts dharma finds no authority in anything else; swollen with trust in his own judgment, he despises what is better."

verses.text:
इन्द्रियप्रीतिसंबद्धं यदिदं लोकसाक्षिकम् ।
एतावान्मन्यते बालो मोहमन्यत्र गच्छति ॥

meaning.en: "The fool thinks only this much, that which is bound up with the pleasure of the senses and is witnessed by the world; he goes elsewhere into delusion."

verses.text:
प्रायश्चित्तं न तस्यास्ति यो धर्ममतिशङ्कते ।
ध्यायन्स कृपणः पापो न लोकान्प्रतिपद्यते ॥

meaning.en: "There is no atonement for one who greatly doubts dharma; brooding, wretched and sinful, he does not reach the worlds."

verses.text:
प्रमाणान्यतिवृत्तो हि वेदशास्त्रार्थनिन्दकः ।
कामलोभानुगो मूढो नरकं प्रतिपद्यते ॥

meaning.en: "One who goes beyond the authorities and reviles the Veda and the meaning of the scriptures, a fool following desire and greed, goes to hell."

verses.text:
यस्तु नित्यं कृतमतिर्धर्ममेवाभिपद्यते ।
अशङ्कमानः कल्याणि सोऽमुत्रानन्त्यमश्नुते ॥

meaning.en: "But whoever always firmly resolved goes to dharma without doubting, fair lady, wins endlessness in the next world."

verses.text:
आर्षं प्रमाणमुत्क्रम्य धर्मानपरिपालयन् ।
सर्वशास्त्रातिगो मूढः शं जन्मसु न विन्दति ॥

meaning.en: "A fool who goes beyond the authority of the sages, does not keep dharma, and breaks all scriptures finds no happiness in his births."

verses.text:
शिष्टैराचरितं धर्मं कृष्णे मा स्मातिशङ्किथाः ।
पुराणमृषिभिः प्रोक्तं सर्वज्ञैः सर्वदर्शिभिः ॥

meaning.en: "Krishna, do not doubt the dharma practiced by the good, which ancient sages, omniscient and all-seeing, have declared."

verses.text:
धर्म एव प्लवो नान्यः स्वर्गं द्रौपदि गच्छताम् ।
सैव नौः सागरस्येव वणिजः पारमृच्छतः ॥

meaning.en: "Dharma alone is the raft, nothing else, for those going to heaven, Draupadi; it is the boat for a merchant seeking the ocean's far shore."

verses.text:
अफालो यदि धर्मः स्याच्चरितो धर्मचारिभिः ।
अप्रतिष्ठे तमस्येतज्जगन्मज्जेदनिन्दिते ॥

meaning.en: "If dharma practiced by the righteous were fruitless, blameless lady, this world would sink into groundless darkness."

verses.text:
निर्वाणं नाधिगच्छेयुर्जीवेयुः पशुजीविकाम् ।
विघातेनैव युज्येयुर्न चार्थं किंचिदाप्नुयुः ॥

meaning.en: "People would not reach liberation but would live a beast's life; they would be joined only to ruin and would gain no purpose."

verses.text:
तपश्च ब्रह्मचर्यं च यज्ञः स्वाध्याय एव च ।
दानमार्जवमेतानि यदि स्युरफलानि वै ॥

meaning.en: "If austerity, celibacy, sacrifice, study, giving and straightforwardness were fruitless,"

verses.text:
नाचरिष्यन्परे धर्मं परे परतरे च ये ।
विप्रलम्भोऽयमत्यन्तं यदि स्युरफलाः क्रियाः ॥

meaning.en: "then neither others nor those before them would have practiced dharma; if actions were fruitless, this would be total deception."

verses.text:
ऋषयश्चैव देवाश्च गन्धर्वासुरराक्षसाः ।
ईश्वराः कस्य हेतोस्ते चरेयुर्धर्ममादृताः ॥

meaning.en: "For whose sake would sages, gods, Gandharvas, asuras and rakshasas, the powerful, practice dharma with devotion?"

verses.text:
फलदं त्विह विज्ञाय धातारं श्रेयसि ध्रुवे ।
धर्मं ते ह्याचरन्कृष्णे तद्धि धर्मसनातनम् ॥

meaning.en: "Knowing that the Ordainer gives fruit and that the highest good is sure, Krishna, they practiced dharma; that is eternal dharma."

verses.text:
स चायं सफलो धर्मो न धर्मोऽफल उच्यते ।
दृश्यन्तेऽपि हि विद्यानां फलानि तपसां तथा ॥

meaning.en: "That dharma is fruitful; dharma is not called fruitless. The fruits of learning and of austerities are in fact seen."

verses.text:
त्वय्येतद्वै विजानीहि जन्म कृष्णे यथा श्रुतम् ।
वेत्थ चापि यथा जातो धृष्टद्युम्नः प्रतापवान् ॥

meaning.en: "Know this about yourself, Krishna, as you have heard of your birth; you also know how the mighty Dhrishtadyumna was born."

verses.text:
एतावदेव पर्याप्तमुपमानं शुचिस्मिते ।
कर्मणां फलमस्तीति धीरोऽल्पेनापि तुष्यति ॥

meaning.en: "This much is example enough, bright-smiling one: the steadfast man is content with a small proof that deeds have fruit."

verses.text:
बहुनापि ह्यविद्वांसो नैव तुष्यन्त्यबुद्धयः ।
तेषां न धर्मजं किंचित्प्रेत्य शर्मास्ति कर्म वा ॥

meaning.en: "But the ignorant and dull are not satisfied even with a great deal; for them there is neither anything born of dharma nor happiness after death, nor deed."

verses.text:
कर्मणामुत पुण्यानां पापानां च फलोदयः ।
प्रभवश्चाप्ययश्चैव देवगुह्यानि भामिनि ॥

meaning.en: "The coming forth of the fruit of good and bad deeds, their origin and their end, shining lady, are secrets of the gods."

verses.text:
नैतानि वेद यः कश्चिन्मुह्यन्त्यत्र प्रजा इमाः ।
रक्ष्याण्येतानि देवानां गूढमाया हि देवताः ॥

meaning.en: "Anyone who does not know these things confuses these people; the gods guard these secrets, for the gods hide their magic."

verses.text:
कृशाङ्गाः सुव्रताश्चैव तपसा दग्धकिल्बिषाः ।
प्रसन्नैर्मानसैर्युक्ताः पश्यन्त्येतानि वै द्विजाः ॥

meaning.en: "Lean-bodied brahmins of good vows, whose sins have been burned by austerity and whose minds are clear, do see these things."

verses.text:
न फलादर्शनाद्धर्मः शङ्कितव्यो न देवताः ।
यष्टव्यं चाप्रमत्तेन दातव्यं चानसूयता ॥

meaning.en: "Do not doubt dharma because you do not see its fruit, nor the gods; one must sacrifice with care and give without envy."

verses.text:
कर्मणां फलमस्तीति तथैतद्धर्म शाश्वतम् ।
ब्रह्मा प्रोवाच पुत्राणां यदृषिर्वेद कश्यपः ॥

meaning.en: "That deeds have fruit is the eternal dharma, which Brahma told his sons and which the sage Kashyapa knows."

verses.text:
तस्मात्ते संशयः कृष्णे नीहार इव नश्यतु ।
व्यवस्य सर्वमस्तीति नास्तिक्यं भावमुत्सृज ॥

meaning.en: "So let your doubt, Krishna, vanish like mist; decide that everything exists and abandon the attitude of unbelief."

verses.text:
ईश्वरं चापि भूतानां धातारं मा विचिक्षिपः ।
शिक्षस्वैनं नमस्वैनं मा ते भूद्बुद्धिरीदृशी ॥

meaning.en: "Do not scorn the Lord, the Ordainer of beings; learn about him and bow to him, and let such a thought never come to you."

verses.text:
यस्य प्रसादात्तद्भक्तो मर्त्यो गच्छत्यमर्त्यताम् ।
उत्तमं दैवतं कृष्णे मातिवोचः कथंचन ॥

meaning.en: "By whose grace a mortal devoted to him attains immortality, Krishna, he is the supreme deity; never speak slightingly of him in any way."
